engine: PrivacyLint Deterministic AST & Pattern Rule Engine
jurisdictionContext: India DPDP Act 2023 (Engineering Triage Mapping — Non-Legal Advisory)

rules.name: Missing Consent Verification on PII-Touching Route
rules.description: API route handler ingests or processes Personal Identifiable Information (email, phone, Aadhaar, PAN, fullName) from request payload without invoking a consent verification middleware or checking explicit user consent flags.
rules.detectionLogic: AST Route Handler Inspection: Identifies Express route definitions (POST/PUT/PATCH) destructuring PII identifiers from req.body without a preceding verifyConsent middleware or consent_timestamp check in the handler scope.
rules.remediationSummary: Insert explicit consent verification middleware (e.g., requireConsent('checkout_pii_processing')) before route controller execution and persist the verified consent artifact ID.

rules.name: Plaintext PII Written to Application Logs
rules.description: Unmasked personal identifiers (email, phone, panNumber, aadhaarNumber, or full req.body) are passed directly to console.log, console.info, or logger sinks, leaking cleartext PII into log aggregators.
rules.detectionLogic: AST CallExpression Sink Analysis: Matches logger/console method invocations whose arguments reference PII variable bindings or raw request payloads without redaction helpers.
rules.remediationSummary: Replace raw object/PII logging with a structured redaction utility (e.g., redactPII(payload)) or log only non-sensitive correlation IDs.

rules.name: Unprotected PII Stored in Browser localStorage/sessionStorage
rules.dpdpReference: DPDP Act §8(5) — Protection Against Unauthorized Access
rules.description: Sensitive user profile attributes or session tokens containing PII are serialized directly into window.localStorage or window.sessionStorage, exposing them to XSS exfiltration.
rules.detectionLogic: AST MemberExpression Check: Detects localStorage.setItem or sessionStorage.setItem calls where the key or serialized value contains phone, email, kyc, pan, or token identifiers.
rules.remediationSummary: Store session state in HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict server cookies and keep sensitive KYC/PII attributes in ephemeral memory only when actively rendered.

rules.name: PII Database Table Without Retention or TTL Policy Signal
rules.description: Database schema or ORM model storing personal data lacks an explicit retention timestamp (expires_at, retention_until, deleted_at) or scheduled purge policy annotation.
rules.detectionLogic: Schema & DDL Inspection: Parses CREATE TABLE / ORM model definitions containing PII columns (email, phone, pan_number, aadhaar_last4) and verifies presence of TTL/retention columns or purge triggers.
rules.remediationSummary: Add a retention_until TIMESTAMPTZ column and register the table in the automated data-retention purge worker when the specified purpose is fulfilled.

rules.name: Unmasked PII Forwarded to Third-Party Analytics
rules.dpdpReference: DPDP Act §8(2) — Data Processor & Third-Party Safeguards
rules.description: User email, mobile number, or government ID is transmitted directly inside analytics.track() or third-party marketing webhook payloads without hashing or pseudonymization.
rules.detectionLogic: AST External Call Graph: Tracks taint flow from user entity fields into analytics.track, mixpanel.people.set, segment.identify, or external axios.post calls.
rules.remediationSummary: Strip direct PII attributes from analytics payloads and use an anonymized internal UUID or salted SHA-256 hash when correlation is strictly consented.

rules.name: Unconsented Third-Party Tracker Loaded on Application Route
rules.dpdpReference: DPDP Act §5 & §6 — Notice Prior to Collection
rules.description: Third-party tracking pixels or telemetry scripts are initialized unconditionally on route render prior to verifying the user's opt-in tracking preference.
rules.detectionLogic: AST Script/Tracker Initialization Check: Identifies unconditional invocation of third-party pixel/beacon initializers without a gating hasTrackingConsent() guard.
rules.remediationSummary: Gate all non-essential third-party tracker initializations behind an explicit consent state check.

rules.name: Missing Age-Gate / Verifiable Parental Consent Signal in Signup Flow
rules.dpdpReference: DPDP Act §9(1) — Processing of Personal Data of Children
rules.description: User registration or onboarding controller accepts dateOfBirth or creates user accounts without checking whether the user is a minor (<18 years) or requiring verifiable guardian consent.
rules.detectionLogic: Signup AST Flow Analysis: Inspects registration endpoints accepting user profile creation without age calculation or minor guardian-consent verification branches.
rules.remediationSummary: Validate dateOfBirth at registration; if age < 18, halt standard onboarding and trigger the Verifiable Parental Consent (VPC) workflow.

rules.name: Missing Breach-Notification Incident Hook on Sensitive Data Store
rules.dpdpReference: DPDP Act §8(6) — Personal Data Breach Intimation
rules.description: Authentication and bulk PII data access modules lack structured security event hooks or anomaly alert triggers required for CERT-In / Data Protection Board breach reporting.
rules.detectionLogic: Security Control Signal Check: Inspects error/unauthorized access handlers on critical PII controllers for audit log and incident alert dispatch calls.
rules.remediationSummary: Wire unauthorized access and bulk-query anomaly events to the SecurityAuditLogger and CERT-In / DPB incident notification webhook.

rules.name: Sensitive PII & Credential Fields Exposed in API Response
rules.dpdpReference: DPDP Act §8(5) — Access Control & Data Minimisation
rules.description: Controller returns full database row (`SELECT *` or raw ORM entity) directly in `res.json(user)`, exposing password_hash, pan_number, phone, and internal KYC metadata to the client.
rules.detectionLogic: AST Response Serialization Check: Detects `res.json()` or `res.send()` calls passing unfiltered database result rows derived from `SELECT *` or unprojected entity queries.
rules.remediationSummary: Project only required non-sensitive columns in SQL queries and apply a strict response DTO schema (e.g., UserPublicProfileSchema) before serialization.

rules.name: PII Written to Unredacted Error / Crash Telemetry
rules.dpdpReference: DPDP Act §8(5) — Safeguards Against Accidental Disclosure
rules.description: Exception catch blocks attach full `req.body` or user objects to error tracking payloads (Sentry.captureException / error response bodies) without scrubbing PII fields.
rules.detectionLogic: AST CatchClause Inspection: Identifies error reporter calls or HTTP 500 responses inside catch blocks that serialize raw request bodies or stack traces.
rules.remediationSummary: Scrub request bodies with a deterministic PII sanitizer before forwarding context to crash telemetry, and return generic error messages to clients.

rules.name: Unscoped Bulk Data Export Endpoint Without Tenant/Owner Guard
rules.description: Data export or CSV download route executes an unscoped query across customer records without enforcing tenant isolation, RBAC role checks, or rate limiting.
rules.detectionLogic: AST Route & SQL Query Analysis: Detects export/download routes executing SQL queries lacking `WHERE user_id = $1` or organization scope predicates and SQL string concatenation.
rules.remediationSummary: Enforce strict RBAC authorization, parameterize the SQL query scoped to the authenticated principal (`WHERE user_id = $1`), and attach rate limiting.

rules.name: Unmapped Privacy Control Evidence in Processing Registry
rules.description: A route handling personal data lacks a machine-readable `@privacyPurpose` annotation or rule mapping entry linking the code path to the organization's Record of Processing Activities (RoPA).
rules.detectionLogic: Metadata & JSDoc AST Check: Checks PII-processing controllers for structured `@privacyPurpose` and `@retentionPolicy` governance annotations.
rules.remediationSummary: Annotate PII-handling controllers with `@privacyPurpose` and register the endpoint in the versioned privacy manifest.
